integrity: The theorem is proved from explicit fibers, a point-separation argument, and a cited published lemma; no numerical evidence or independent mathematical verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to real C^1([0,1]) with the exponent-one anchored norm, the nonnegative initial value/derivative positive sphere, and surjective positive-sum-norm preservers. Uses the existing positive-sphere C(K) Banach–Stone theorem of Ezumi and Miura; claims no extension to nonsurjective maps or other domains.
title: Complete endpoint classification of positive-sphere norm-additive maps on \(C^1([0,1])\)
